title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 192 (Representation of principal by sub-agent properly appointed)

content.overview: Section 192 provides that where a sub-agent is properly appointed, the principal is, so far as regards third persons, represented by the sub-agent, and is bound by and responsible for his acts, as if he were an agent originally appointed by the principal. The agent is responsible to the principal for the acts of the sub-agent. The sub-agent is responsible for his acts to the agent, but not to the principal, except in cases of fraud or wilful wrong.
content.glance: Where a sub-agent is properly appointed, the principal is represented by and bound by the sub-agent as regards third persons as if the sub-agent had been originally appointed by the principal. The agent is responsible to the principal for the sub-agent’s acts. The sub-agent is responsible to the agent, not to the principal, except for fraud or wilful wrong.

sections.heading: Representation of principal
sections.body: Where a sub-agent is properly appointed, the principal is, so far as regards third persons, represented by the sub-agent, and is bound by and responsible for his acts, as if he were an agent originally appointed by the principal.

sections.heading: Agent’s responsibility
sections.body: The agent is responsible to the principal for the acts of the sub-agent.

sections.heading: Sub-agent’s responsibility
sections.body: The sub-agent is responsible for his acts to the agent, but not to the principal, except in cases of fraud or wilful wrong.

examples.title: Properly appointed sub-agent
examples.body: A properly appointed sub-agent represents the principal as regards third persons. The agent is responsible to the principal for the sub-agent’s acts; the sub-agent is responsible to the agent (except for fraud or wilful wrong) under Section 192.

hypotheticals.question: A sub-agent is properly appointed. Is the principal bound by the sub-agent’s acts as regards third persons?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. Under Section 192 the principal is, so far as regards third persons, represented by the sub-agent and is bound by and responsible for his acts as if the sub-agent had been originally appointed by the principal.

distinctions.title: Scope of Section 192
